newsitem.title: USA: Ronson says extends exchange offer.
newsitem.headline: Ronson says extends exchange offer.

text.p: Ronson Corp said it extended its previously announced exchange offer to owners of its 12 percent cumulative convertible preferred stock for shares of common stock.
Ronson extended the offer to July 21, from the previously announced expiration date of June 19.
According to the offer, preferred shareholders can exchange each preferred share for 1.7 common shares.

Other than the extension, Ronson said all terms conditions of the offer remain the same. The company said it has received and accepted about 79 percent of the preferred shares for exchange so far under the offer.
Ronson manufactures and markets consumer products, including butane and liquid fuel lighters and components.
